sections.heading: 1. Knee lift hold
lines: ① Sit tall, hand resting on top of your knee.
② Lift the knee gently into your hand.
③ Hold 10 sec × 5, twice a day.
④ Then march → lunge → kick, step by step.

caption:
Front of Toto's hip grabbing every time there's a kick or sprint?

Soccer, footy, touch and Oztag all put big demands on the hip flexors, especially late in a game. A strain usually shows up as pain at the front of the hip or top of the thigh.

Most people do better staying active within comfort, then building strength gradually: gentle knee lift holds, then marching and lunges, then resisted drives. Kicking comes last, starting short and slow.

A pop, bruising or trouble walking is worth an assessment. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can build your return-to-kicking plan. Book online via the link in bio ⚽
